title: BUGFIX — Auto-deliver message still uses /record <id> 0 format (missing tiktok_url prompt)
rationale: Sprint 1373 fixed /record prompts in cmd-delivery.ts (Telegram bot commands), but posting-auto-deliver.ts:373 still sends '/record ${videoId} 0' without the tiktok_url placeholder. Auto-deliver is the PRIMARY delivery mechanism (3x/day via PM2 cron: 07:30, 12:00, 18:00). Every auto-deliver message the operator receives shows /record <id> 0 without URL — so the operator copies it and records without a URL. This is why all 16 posts have tiktok_url: undefined and views are stuck at 0.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/posting-auto-deliver.ts line 373: change 'Save video → post to TikTok → /record ${videoId} 0' to 'Save video → post to TikTok → /record ${videoId} 0 <tiktok_url>'.
